messages:
Mei: Quick review: export modal for embeddings preview. Main asks: column order, filename pattern, and SR copy.

Sam: Column order proposal: id, text, model_score, embedding_id, label. Puts score close to text for quick scanning.

Aisha: a11y: for filename we should include content hint in SR only, e.g., aria-label on download: "Download CSV: embeddings preview, 12 rows, includes model scores". Also ensure the export button has aria-describedby linking to a short sr-only summary.

Marta: Copy tweak for modal body: current: "Export current view". Suggest: "Export the currently visible rows and columns (applies filters and sort)." Secondary small text: "You can export raw parsed rows in advanced options."

Sam: Filename suggestion: vectors_export_2026-03-23_filters.csv (ISO date). For filters, use short slug of active filter like 'high-score'. Keep max length tidy.

Aisha: Tooltip & keyboard: the tooltip for "Why model_score?" must appear on focus and hover and be reachable by keyboard. Use role=tooltip and aria-expanded on trigger. Tooltip text: "Model score is the rerankers numeric relevance (higher = more relevant)."

export-bot: Export preview: rows=12, cols=[id,text,model_score,embedding_id,label], sample_link=https://figma.example/vecexp123

Mei: Final ask: SR pre-download summary should read: "Preparing download: 12 rows, 5 columns, includes model scores and user labels. Press Enter to confirm." Any objections?

Sam: No objections. LGTM.

Aisha: One more: color coding for model_score needs text alternatives; add aria-hidden icons and an adjacent sr-only text like "High score".

Mei: Thanks all, I'll update the mock and push the figma link here when ready.
